Subject: Discovery follow-up + VP/CTO intro - next steps

Hi Emily / Carlos -

Thanks again for the time today - appreciate the transparency on your latency and cost sensitivity for the chat assistant initiative. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps:

Recap (big points):
- Primary goal: reduce per-conversation token cost and ensure sub-300ms p95 response for logged-in users.
- Current infra: Kubernetes-hosted model endpoints (mixed GPU types), limited caching, some burst needs for marketing events.
- Key must-haves: VPC/private deployment option, SLAs for peak events, ability to pin model versions and run A/B rollouts.

What I can action this week:
- Shared call notes (attached) and a draft mutual action plan outlining milestones and success criteria.
- Recommend an executive alignment intro (VP/CTO) so we can align on compliance and procurement timelines and unblock a technical deep dive/demo with one of our solutions engineers.

Proposal for next steps:
1) Executive alignment (30 min) - VP/CTO intro to cover procurement timelines, compliance (VPC/KMS), and roadmap fit.
2) Technical deep dive & demo (45 min) - solutions engineer + infra team to walk through deployment options, latency optimization, and a small POC scope.

Suggested windows (PST):
- Tue 6/11: 10:00-11:00 or 15:00-16:00
- Wed 6/12: 09:00-11:00 or 14:00-16:00

If you can share the right exec(s) to include (CTO or VP Eng) and their availability, I'll coordinate calendars. I've attached the call notes and a draft MAP for your review.

Attachments: 20290605-zenlyx-call-notes.pdf, zenlyx-mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Thanks -
